title: E0062: Command injection
plain_english: This rule reports shell command calls where user-controlled input reaches the command argument. An attacker may be able to inject additional shell syntax or commands.
why_matters: Command injection can allow arbitrary command execution on the server, which may lead to data exposure, data loss, or full system compromise.
what_it_checks: Shell execution functions such as `system()`, `exec()`, `shell_exec()`, `passthru()`, `popen()`, and `proc_open()`
Cases where user-controlled input reaches the command argument, based on taint analysis and dynamic-expression heuristics
